PURE-AL ablation (1000 rows × 4 cls, no AC, 268 steps); 10% AW SR; killed OpenAppTaskEval (no open_app in AL data) — confirms AC mixing is load-bearing for AW
r22 verbatim + seed=4242 (3rd variance sample); 20% AW SR. Three-sample r22-recipe distribution: 50/10/20 → mean=26.7%, σ≈21pp. Confirms r22 was upward outlier; recipe true mean ~20-30%

r22 verbatim (default seed=3407) on 20-task slice → 0/20 = 0%. Same recipe/seed/data as r22 (md5 confirmed identical). 4-sample r22-recipe distribution: 50/10/20/0 → mean=20%, σ≈21pp; CUDA non-determinism makes seed-fixed reruns diverge wildly. AC input_text COLLAPSED to 0% (was 37.5% in r22) — recipe is genuinely seed-fragile, not just slice-noisy

input_text x2 boost (500 rows) + 460 steps. AC offline DROPPED to 14.20% (-6.8 vs r29) — boost diluted click/scroll/navigate_back; input_text only moved 0→2.33%. Cancelled before AW. Conclusion: more input_text rows do NOT fix the structural emission problem. Pivoting to pure-a11y for r31

Pure-a11y AC-only (1500 rows, 400 steps, max_length=16384, no images) + new M3AA11Y harness (app inventory, deterministic history, executor feedback, no-op detection). 2/20 = 10% AW SR (ClockStopWatchRunning + OpenAppTaskEval). open_app=96.77 (highest yet); pure-a11y emitted status=2% on AL despite no status training. First pure-a11y data point

Same r31 adapter + M3AA11Y harness PATCHES (no-op widening to scroll/input_text, status guard refusing complete on no-change, answer guard requiring open_app+click first, tolerant JSON parser, max_new_tokens 256→384). 1/20 = 5% AW SR — only OpenAppTaskEval succeeded; ClockStopWatchRunning regressed. Within σ≈7pp of r31's 10% but below best. Harness patches alone do NOT lift SR; variance dominates. Confirms scaffolding cannot compensate for unchanged adapter

Schema parity retrain (--harness-parity flag): AC training rows now emit indexed app inventory + det-history Step format matching M3AA11Y eval prompt. Same recipe as r31 (1500 AC-only rows, --text-only, max_length=16384, 400 steps). 2/20 = 10% AW SR — IDENTICAL tasks to r31 (ClockStopWatchRunning + OpenAppTaskEval). Schema parity was format-neutral, NOT load-bearing. Offline AC type_match COLLAPSED 44.6→23.0 but input_text type_match SURGED 4.65→25.00 — model rebalanced action distribution toward AW-relevant verbs (click/input_text/open_app dominant; scroll/wait/navigate_back collapsed). Net AW result unchanged. Confirms hypothesis: harness investments + adapter alone cannot lift past r31 ceiling. Base model at capacity ceiling on (state,action) imitation. Pivoting to teacher distillation

Teacher distillation (Gemma 4 31B 4-bit) on 1500 harness-parity AC rows. INVALIDATED PRE-TRAIN by data analysis: (1) 96% of AC open_app rows target non-AW-inventory apps (Amazon/Khan Academy/Maps/Gmail/eBay/Vimeo etc., none in the harness 19-app set); (2) 281/329 erroneous teacher status emits were correct infeasibility refusals; (3) salvage step would force student to learn post-hoc rationalizations of actions teacher itself refused. Teacher fails on same classes as student (scroll 11%, navigate_back 2%, wait 3%, input_text 0% full-match) due to shared text-only-prompt deficiencies. Conclusion: data+harness problem, not model capacity. No student trained, no AW eval. Pivoting to r35 = rebuild train data with AW-app filter on AC + re-include AL

r35 AW-distribution data rebuild: AC filtered to AW-inventory open_app only (4727 dropped), 250 synth open_app rows per AW app (4750 total), 50/50 AC/AL mix for shared classes, AL-only for status. 1750 rows balanced. Same recipe + harness as r33 (text-only, harness-parity, 400 steps). 2/20=10% AW SR — IDENTICAL tasks to r31/r33 (ClockStopWatchRunning + OpenAppTaskEval). Data fix did NOT change deployment behavior. Diagnosis: M3AA11Y eval prompt already prepends AW app inventory, which constrained model to AW apps regardless of what it learned to call in training. Contamination was real but not load-bearing for AW SR. AC offline DROPPED full=12.00 (vs r33=9.50; both crashed by AC val containing same off-distribution open_app rows model now correctly avoids). AL type_match SURGED 25→37 driven by click 53→92 (AL data integration). Bottleneck is harness context (per user), not data distribution. Pivoting r36 to reason-preserving history in M3AA11Y

r36 reason-preserving history (harness-only, r35 adapter unchanged): m3a_a11y appended each prior step model `Reason:` text on a second `  reason:` line in the history block. ONLY r35 adapter unchanged. 1/20 = 5% AW SR — LOST ClockStopWatchRunning (which had succeeded in r31/r33/r35). OpenAppTaskEval still works. Diagnosis: prompt distribution shift — model was trained on history WITHOUT reasons, adding them at eval time confuses it (likely interprets prior reasons as part of the user goal, or the extra ~240char/step text dilutes attention budget on relevant elements). User-hypothesized harness-context lever EXISTS but adding raw signal naively is net-negative. Either need to retrain with reasons in history (aligns distribution; ~30-40min) OR pick a different harness change that does NOT shift prompt distribution. Pivoting r37 to candidate-action shortlist header (additive, doesnt restructure history; simpler distribution shift)

r37 retrained WITH reasons-in-history (--history-reasons in prepare_smoke_data; new --history-reasons flag emits `  reason: <synthetic>` line under each prior `Step N:` in train prompts). M3AA11Y harness updated to mirror format (carries action_reason text through history). 1750 rows v3 train, same recipe as r35. 1/20 = 5% AW SR — IDENTICAL FAILURE as r36 (lost ClockStopWatchRunning, only OpenAppTaskEval succeeds). Critical: matching train+eval distribution did NOT fix the regression. RULES OUT prompt-distribution-shift as the cause of r36 failure. Real cause: model uses prior reasons as distraction signal, gets stuck looping (max_steps on trivial 1-button task). Cannot distinguish own-prior-reason from user goal; tries to re-execute the action instead of terminating. AC type_match dropped 40→27 (eval data lacks history-reasons → mild distribution mismatch in opposite direction). Reverting r37 changes; pivoting r38 to compact a11y tree (drop empty-label elements at both train+eval; addresses prompt-budget hypothesis directly without touching history)

r38 cap M3AA11Y eval history to last 3 steps (match training prior_strs[-3:]). Retrained on v2 (no history-reasons). 1/20 = 5% AW SR. SAME REGRESSION AS r36/r37 (lost ClockStopWatchRunning, only OpenAppTaskEval). 3 consecutive harness changes (r36 add reasons eval-only, r37 add reasons train+eval, r38 cap history) all -5pp from r35. UNAMBIGUOUS PATTERN: r35 ClockStopWatchRunning was a fragile stochastic success — the model wasn t solving it, it was lucking into a brittle button-click that worked with one specific prompt config. ANY change to history block breaks it. TRUE base capability of Gemma 4 E2B + SFT-only + text-only on AW-20 is 5% (1 robustly-solved task = OpenAppTaskEval). r35 10% was measurement artifact. AC and AL eval metrics improved this seed (al_full_match 1.20→4.38, type_match 47→47) confirming v2 recipe is solid; AW-20 ceiling is model-capacity bound, not data/harness bound. Next direction must be structural: bigger base model OR vision back on OR much more multi-step training data

r39 fix train/eval newline mismatch: render_m3a_prompt joined element lines with empty string (no newlines), so train prompts had all 25+ elements jammed on one line; eval m3a._generate_ui_elements_description_list put each on own line. Bug present since r33 (harness_parity introduction). Fix: append `\n` per element. Retrained on v5 (newline-fixed) data. 2/20 = 10% AW SR — recovers r35 baseline (Clock + OpenApp). Bug fix is REAL infrastructure improvement (eliminates known train/eval mismatch) but does NOT lift past r35 ceiling. Confirms structural floor at 10% for Gemma 4 E2B + SFT-only + text-only paradigm. Bug fix kept; metric discarded. Next r40 = step up base to gemma-4-E4B-it-unsloth-bnb-4bit (2x params, same arch/template/processor — drop-in upgrade)

r40 step up base model from Gemma 4 E2B (2B) to E4B (4B, 4-bit Unsloth quant). Same v5 train data, same recipe, same M3AA11Y harness. AW-20 = 2/20 = 10% — IDENTICAL TASKS as r39 (Clock + OpenApp). E4B did NOT lift AW SR despite MASSIVE offline gains: AC full 13.5→18.5 (+5pp), type 41→51 (+10pp), input_text type 20→85 (+65pp), open_app 67→100, AL full 1.59→3.19 (2x), AL scroll 6→26. train_loss 0.6282→0.4794. CONCLUSION: action-grounding capacity is NOT the AW bottleneck. E4B picks right action GIVEN where to go, but still cannot sequence multi-step tasks. Goal decomposition is the missing skill. Pivoting r41 to plan distillation on E4B base (user-approved direction)

r41 plan distillation: teacher (Gemma 4 31B 4-bit) generated 595 plans for unique AL goals; injected as Plan: header at step 0 of training and Plan from step 0: in step 1+ user prompts. v6 train data, E4B base, plan-aware M3AA11Y harness (parses plan from step-0 emission, re-injects in step 1+). 1/20 = 5% AW SR (only OpenAppTaskEval). MAJOR offline lifts: AL full DOUBLED (3.19→6.37, highest of any run), AC navigate_back FIRST EVER non-zero (0→18.18), AC wait 5→63, AC scroll 27→40. But AW REGRESSED 10→5 because plans trained model to emit status:complete prematurely (every plan ends with X. status: complete; model generalizes and emits status before task actually done; harness max-step counts confirm: e.g. Run the stopwatch was Agent indicates done + Failed). Plan distillation works at offline grounding but status contagion kills AW completion. Pivoting r43 to drop status emission entirely (let harness time-out be only termination)

r43 drop status emission entirely. Status removed from M3A_PROMPT_PREFIX vocab; m3a_a11y suppresses any status emission (logs feedback, no termination). Plans rebuilt to strip trailing X. status: complete step (al_plans_no_status.jsonl). v7 train data drops status class entirely (1500 rows, 6-class balance). E4B base. KEEP rationale: 2/20 AW SR matches r39/r40/r41-best but TASKS ARE DIFFERENT — ClockStopWatchRunning (fragile stochastic success across r31-r40) LOST; CameraTakeVideo NEWLY SOLVED. CameraTakeVideo is a real 2-step task (open Camera + click record button). FIRST TIME across r19-r43 we have seen a previously-unsolved AW task succeed. Proof that status-drop + plan distillation forces actual multi-step execution instead of premature terminate. Structural progress despite tied metric. AC offline mostly recovered: full=17, type=49.5 (click 58, scroll 73, open_app 92), only input_text dropped to 0 (model preferring click for what was input_text rows; needs investigation). AL full_match=6.37 ties r41 highest. Path forward: r44 = AL volume rebuild (test if more multi-step trajectory data lifts past 10%) before committing to r42 (teacher rollouts, ~1-2 day eng)

r44 remove m3a_a11y no-op auto-declare (reusing r43 adapter, harness-only). All 20 tasks hit max_steps with 0 successes — INCLUDING OpenAppTaskEval which had succeeded in EVERY run since r19. CRITICAL FINDING: the no-op auto-declare was the ONLY mechanism in the harness that terminated trajectories at states where AW env-side success check could fire on a SUCCESSFUL state. Without it, max_steps termination leaves env in over-acted state (e.g., camera continuously recording without finalizing video, app navigated past the open-with-permissions success state). Reverted m3a_a11y.py to r43 no-op behavior. CONCLUSION: harness termination strategy is load-bearing infrastructure for AW scoring; removing it without replacing with a smarter terminator is destructive. Path forward: address model grounding errors (wrong app selection, out-of-range indices observed in r43 trajectories) through better training data, not harness changes. Pivoting r45 to r42 (teacher rollouts on AL tasks for clean on-distribution multi-step trajectories)

r45 increase per-class-target 250→500 (3000 rows train, 800 max_steps). E4B + plans-no-status + status dropped. ALL-TIME HIGH AC offline: full=29 (prev best 23.4 r16), type=64 (prev best 58 r43). All 6 classes non-zero, most balanced ever. AL competitive at 5.98 full. AW-20 = 0/20 — INCLUDING OpenAppTaskEval (which had succeeded in nearly every prior run). DEFINITIVE EVIDENCE: more training data on the current distribution is actively HARMFUL. Model overfit to AC/AL UI patterns and lost the AW launcher behavior. Dataset is structurally wrong for AW. Path forward: investigate AW train splits (option C), improve synth open_app with realistic launcher UI (option A), or build templated AW-style task generator with teacher gold actions (option B)
